authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: "If (after making the above adjustments) the minimum-integer-part-size and the minimum-fractional-part-size are both zero, then the minimum-fractional-part-size is set to 1 (one)". maximum-fractional-part-size is 3 here, so the earlier "both zero" adjustment does not fire; this final one does, and 4.7.5 pads the single fractional zero digit.
